output_list.reason: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply + value <= TOKEN_LIMIT check is bypassed if value is crafted to overflow.
The transfer function allows the owner to transfer tokens to any address, including 0x0, causing a loss of funds.
The transferFrom function allows any spender to transfer tokens from the owner's account, also causing a loss of funds.
The approve function allows any spender to transfer tokens from the owner's account, also causing a loss of funds.
The migrate function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The value <= balances[msg.sender] check is bypassed if value is crafted to overflow.
